# Puny Characters — Shade

The unmodified `Character-Base.png` was extracted from Shade's public
[OpenGameArt upload](https://opengameart.org/content/puny-characters), published
2022-05-29. That artist upload and the [artist's itch.io page](https://merchant-shade.itch.io/16x16-puny-characters)
both explicitly license these sprites under **Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal**.
Verified 2026-09-12. The downloaded archive does not contain a separate license
file; this notice records the artist's license declaration without claiming one.

License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

The source sheet is 768×256 pixels, divided into 32×32 frames. This project uses
only its first two unarmed, front-facing frames. Their visible bodies occupy
roughly 14×13 pixels within the larger transparent frame. Original pixel edits
add civilian clothing, hair, gardener hat and cook cap; outlines are remapped
to the environment's purple ink. No weapons, combat animations or audio ship.

The archive URL, archive SHA-256 and exact extracted-file hash are pinned in
`../sources.json`.
